page.layout: One page of text in a single column. The title block sits at the top, followed by the chapter list with hanging numbers in the left margin. At the foot are the signature mark and a running title "II. PARS" at the right. No text in the margins.

main_text.head: ELENCHVS CAPITVM NATVRÆ MYSTERIORVM Nuclei.
main_text.l: 1. De corpore Naturali, ubi de Natura & actione naturæ varia.
main_text.head: I. PARS PHYSICÆ, scilicet ACROAMATICA.
main_text.l: 2. De corporum naturalium Principiis externis & internis.
3. De communibus affectionibus Corp. Nat. & quidem primo de Mutabilitate, Motu Physico vario & Quiete.
4. Secundo de finitate, scilicet, Loco & Tempore physico.
5. De propriis affectionibus corporum Naturalium, nempe Qualitatibus manifestis & occultis.
6. De qualitatibus actualibus Sensilibus, actualibus Tactilibus primis.

page.notes: The foot running title "II. PARS" is printed at the right, below the last line; it is transcribed in main_text as printed. The signature ")( f" at the left is uncertain: the final letter may be a long s or f, marked [?]. The "ꝰ" in line 7 is a printed abbreviation for -us, transcribed as it appears. Numerals are copied as printed, including the "11." and "10." of the list. The numbers 2 and 4 carry a small mark that may be a printer's ornament; no change made.
